error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Ambeo Soundbar. Please verify the host and ensure the soundbar is powered on.
error.unsupported_model: This soundbar model is not supported.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the logs for details.

data_description.concurrent_requests: Maximum number of simultaneous HTTP requests sent to the soundbar during a poll cycle. Lower values reduce load on the device's embedded server (default: 3).
